target_granularity: Maximal coherent region separated from peers by substantial whitespace, a distinct semantic role, or a non-text object.

text_region.include: Contiguous body-text block, including multiple adjacent lines or paragraphs when no substantial separator exists.
text_region.exclude: Standalone titles, running headers, captions, marginalia, page numbers, ornaments and stamps.
text_region.review_rule: Reject a page-sized body box when it encloses multiple independently supported semantic or whitespace-separated regions. Do not reuse its single teacher vote for every child box.

heading.include: Standalone title or section heading visually separated from body text.
heading.exclude: First body line, running header and typographic ornament.
heading.review_rule: Prefer heading over text_region when the same compact box is a centered or otherwise isolated title.

table.include: Region whose information is organized in rows and columns.
table.exclude: Aligned prose or a single list without column structure.

figure.include: Pictorial, decorative or non-text graphic, including ornaments, seals and stamps.
figure.exclude: Decorated glyphs that remain part of a text line.
figure.review_rule: An isolated printer ornament is figure even when a generic detector calls it text_region or page_number.

caption.include: Text explicitly attached to and describing a figure or table.
caption.exclude: Nearby body text without a clear attachment.

marginalia.include: Text or annotation placed in a page margin outside the main reading flow.

header.include: Running text repeated or positioned above the main page content.

footer.include: Running text repeated or positioned below the main page content.
footer.exclude: Closing body lines, ornaments and page numbers.

page_number.include: Printed Arabic or Roman numeral identifying the page.
page_number.exclude: Ornaments, signatures, catchwords and handwritten marks.
page_number.review_rule: A decorative mark without a readable numeral is not a page number.
